changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: AVISA GROUNDNUT TANZANIA 2022
study.description: On-farm trials implemented under the scope of AVISA and 1000FARMS projects to test new groundnut varieties on-farm. Results are reported in Daudi H, Bujiku AM, Oteng-Frimpong R, Mwololo J, Ojiewo CO, Rathore A, Das B, de Sousa K, Nabateregga M, van Etten J, Shimelis H (2026). Analysis of genotype-by-environment interaction, farmers' preferences, and gender response in groundnut breeding in Tanzania using triadic comparison of technologies. Food and Energy Security, e70228. https://doi.org/10.1002/fes3.70228. The on-farm tricot testing of 2021 to 2023 also informs Rutsaert P, Masimane J, Mawia H, Kitoto V, de Sousa K, van Etten J, Daudi H, Ochieng J, Rubyogo JC, Ojiewo C (2023). Market intelligence insights for groundnut breeding and seed systems in Tanzania. CIMMYT, Nairobi, Kenya. https://hdl.handle.net/10883/22773.

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

genotypes.remarks: Tested as ICGV-SM 16592 and released as TARIKA 1 in July 2024
This is the material from first cross done at Naliendele and it has allele for rust and LLS resistance

funder.awardTitle: Accelerated Varietal Improvement and Seed Delivery of Legumes and Cereals in Africa – AVISA
